description: This Java class defines a tasklet for resolving custom job parameters related to loan COB (Closure of Business) in a batch processing context, utilizing Spring Batch framework. It implements the Tasklet interface, injects a resolver, and executes the resolution during batch job execution.

classes.name: ResolveLoanCOBCustomJobParametersTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that resolves custom job parameters for loan COB processes, using a provided resolver.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the resolution of specified job parameters during batch processing and indicates completion status.
